en-US.author: Astral Software Inc.
en-US.description: An extremely fast Python type checker and language server, written in Rust.
en-US.name: ty
en-US.releaseNotes:
Core type checking
- Infer the types of Django model primary keys (pk and the automatic id) with django-types (#29642)
- Infer Django foreign key <field>_id types from the referenced field (#29664)
- Recognize get_<field>_display() on Django model fields with choices (#29651)
- Recognize get_next_by_<field>() and get_previous_by_<field>() on non-nullable Django date and datetime fields (#29653)

Bug fixes
- Preserve generic callback parameters when forwarding overloaded functions through a ParamSpec (#29649)
- Check implicit and PEP 613 type aliases as type expressions at their definitions (#29200)

CLI
- Emit SARIF reports with ty check --output-format sarif (#29635)

LSP server
- Skip scanning for scripts at startup and reload when uv script environments are disabled (#29697)

Diagnostic improvements
- Abbreviate large nested tuple types in diagnostics and inlay hints (#29691)
- Point to the expression that makes a type alias invalid, even when the alias is imported (#29654)

Performance
- Avoid redundant work when checking inherited attributes (#29699)
- Check for instance storage without inferring method assignments (#29709)
- Collect receiver annotations once per class (#29703)
- Check non-recursive protocol members before recursive ones (#29542)
- Reuse class member lookups when checking overrides (#29716)
- Reuse each generic context's inferable type variables (#29700)
- Short-circuit comparisons involving top and bottom callable signatures (#29537)
- Skip inferred writes when a declaration determines an instance member (#29702)
- Skip method signature inference for concrete decorator results (#29708)
